summary: Teacher urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure students have access to essential connectivity for education.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would deprive students of access to essential connectivity
claims.evidence_quote: Cutting off connectivity for my students would deprive them of access to the lessons and educational tools that are the standard of education. AP Seminar, the research and presentation class I've taught for two years, would be nearly impossible without technology and reliable connection.
